name: BerrySMP
description:
Welcome to BerrySMP!

Our community is super friendly and we all love to play on BerrySMP: a java + bedrock crossplay server that utilizes a custom resource pack, custom terrain generation, custom features, and is frequently updated with new content & new Minecraft releases!

We strive to take suggestions from the community and make changes to benefit all of our players.

If joining on bedrock/console/phone, use IP org.berrysmp.net and Port 19132
